skills.detailZh: 能跨越大範圍裂谷與浮空路線，減少對固定橋樑的依賴。

skills.detailEn: Uses wind pressure and aerial momentum to attack hard-to-reach targets.
skills.detailZh: 以風壓與俯衝動能打擊高處或難以接近的目標。

skills.detailEn: Scouts routes, rooftops, and island gaps before committing resources.
skills.detailZh: 可先行偵查高處、屋頂與浮島裂谷，降低施工風險。

pokemon.descriptionEn: If Shroomish senses danger, it shakes its body and scatters spores from the top of its head. This Pokémon’s spores are so toxic, they make trees and weeds wilt.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 蘑蘑菇一旦察覺危險，就會晃動身體，從頭頂灑出孢子。這些孢子毒性極強，甚至能讓樹木與雜草迅速枯萎。

skills.detailEn: Accelerates growth cycles and keeps planting plots productive through bad weather.
skills.detailZh: 加速作物成長循環，讓農地在惡劣環境下仍保持收成。

skills.detailEn: Launches sharp leaves to prune growth, trigger plant systems, or strike from mid-range.
skills.detailZh: 拋射葉刃修整植被、啟動植物機關，並進行中距離打擊。

skills.detailEn: Raises the output of crops, seeds, and greenery-based habitats nearby.
skills.detailZh: 可提升附近農作物、種子與植栽棲地的產出。

pokemon.descriptionEn: The seeds ringing Breloom’s tail are made of hardened toxic spores. It is horrible to eat the seeds. Just taking a bite of this Pokémon’s seed will cause your stomach to rumble.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 斗笠菇尾巴周圍一圈種子，其實是硬化後的毒孢子。那些種子難吃得驚人，只要咬上一口就足以讓肚子翻攪不適。

skills.detailEn: Accelerates growth cycles and keeps planting plots productive through bad weather.

skills.detailEn: Launches sharp leaves to prune growth, trigger plant systems, or strike from mid-range.

skills.detailEn: Raises the output of crops, seeds, and greenery-based habitats nearby.

pokemon.descriptionEn: Slakoth’s heart beats just once a minute. Whatever happens, it is content to loaf around motionless. It is rare to see this Pokémon in motion.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 懶人獺的心臟一分鐘只跳動一次。無論發生什麼事，牠都喜歡懶洋洋地趴著不動，因此很少有人看見牠真正活動的模樣。

pokemon.descriptionEn: Vigoroth is simply incapable of remaining still. Even when it tries to sleep, the blood in its veins grows agitated, compelling this Pokémon to run wild throughout the jungle before it can settle down.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 過動猿天生無法靜下來。即使想睡，血液一沸騰起來，牠也會先在叢林裡四處狂奔，之後才有辦法安定下來。

pokemon.descriptionZh: 有時會在土裡生活 １０年以上。會從樹木 的根部吸取營養。

pokemon.descriptionZh: 行動十分迅速的寶可夢。 說牠無論什麼攻擊都能避開也不誇張。 非常喜歡甘甜的樹液。

skills.detailEn: Shortens the hunt for secret murals, slates, and golden dig sites.
skills.detailZh: 可縮短尋找隱藏壁畫、石板與發光挖掘點的時間。

pokemon.descriptionEn: Marshtomp is much faster at traveling through mud than it is at swimming. This Pokémon’s hindquarters exhibit obvious development, giving it the ability to walk on just its hind legs.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 沼躍魚在泥地中前進的速度比游泳還快。牠發達的後半身讓牠能輕鬆只靠後腿直立行走。

skills.detailEn: Restores dry ground, clears sludge, and sustains fragile habitat patches.
skills.detailZh: 能滋潤乾地、沖刷泥堆並維持脆弱棲地。

skills.detailEn: Fires a strong stream that drenches dry land, clears sludge, and knocks targets back.
skills.detailZh: 噴射強力水流，可澆灌乾地、沖刷泥堆並擊退目標。

skills.detailEn: Washes away compacted mud and reveals routes, items, and buried targets.
skills.detailZh: 能沖開厚重泥堆，露出路線、素材與埋藏目標。

pokemon.descriptionEn: Delcatty sleeps anywhere it wants without keeping a permanent nest. If other Pokémon approach it as it sleeps, this Pokémon will never fight—it will just move away somewhere else.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 優雅貓沒有固定巢穴，想睡在哪裡就睡在哪裡。即使其他寶可夢靠近牠休息的地方，牠也不會爭鬥，只會安靜地換個地方離開。

skills.detailEn: Carries people and cargo into special routes that normal travel cannot reach.
skills.detailZh: 能將人員與物資送往一般移動方式無法抵達的特殊路線。

skills.detailEn: Slips around obstacles and startles targets with drifting aerial pressure.
skills.detailZh: 可繞開障礙並以飄移軌跡製造出奇不意的壓迫。

skills.detailEn: Links distant or random spaces to the main adventure flow.
skills.detailZh: 把遙遠或隨機生成的區域重新接回主線探索流程。

pokemon.descriptionEn: It feeds on gemstone crystals. In darkness, its eyes sparkle with the glitter of jewels.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 會去吃寶石的結晶。 雙眼在漆黑一片的地方 會發出寶石的光芒。

skills.detailEn: Detects hidden dig spots, murals, and buried quest items in the field.
skills.detailZh: 能感測隱藏挖掘點、壁畫機關與埋藏任務物件。

skills.detailEn: Targets weak spots after locking onto hidden seams or buried objects.
skills.detailZh: 在鎖定裂縫與埋藏目標後，能精準打擊弱點。

skills.detailEn: Shortens the hunt for secret murals, slates, and golden dig sites.
skills.detailZh: 可縮短尋找隱藏壁畫、石板與發光挖掘點的時間。

pokemon.descriptionEn: When Aron evolves, its steel armor peels off. In ancient times, people would collect Aron’s shed armor and make good use of it in their daily lives.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 進化時身上的鋼鐵盔甲 會脫落。以前的人會把 它撿起來用在生活上。

skills.detailEn: Shapes metal components, tools, and gears needed for advanced construction.
skills.detailZh: 能鍛造金屬零件、工具與高階建築所需齒輪。

skills.detailEn: Brings down a decisive hammer strike suited for metal-heavy obstacles.
skills.detailZh: 能用巨鎚打出決定性重擊，對金屬障礙尤其有效。

skills.detailEn: Produces special gears and forged parts for lifts and high-tier builds.
skills.detailZh: 可打造升降平台與高階工程需要的特殊齒輪與鍛件。

pokemon.descriptionEn: During territorial disputes, Lairon fight by slamming into each other. Close inspection of their steel armor reveals scratches and dents.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 會互相碰撞身體來爭奪地盤。 仔細看牠的鋼鐵盔甲，就會 發現有傷痕及凹痕。

skills.detailEn: Shapes metal components, tools, and gears needed for advanced construction.
skills.detailZh: 能鍛造金屬零件、工具與高階建築所需齒輪。

skills.detailEn: Brings down a decisive hammer strike suited for metal-heavy obstacles.
skills.detailZh: 能用巨鎚打出決定性重擊，對金屬障礙尤其有效。

skills.detailEn: Produces special gears and forged parts for lifts and high-tier builds.
skills.detailZh: 可打造升降平台與高階工程需要的特殊齒輪與鍛件。

pokemon.descriptionEn: Long ago, there was a king who wore a helmet meant to resemble the head of an Aggron. He was trying to channel the Pokémon’s strength.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 古時候有位國王將自己的頭盔 製作成波士可多拉頭部的樣子， 期盼為自己帶來像牠的強大力量。

skills.detailEn: Shapes metal components, tools, and gears needed for advanced construction.
skills.detailZh: 能鍛造金屬零件、工具與高階建築所需齒輪。

skills.detailEn: Brings down a decisive hammer strike suited for metal-heavy obstacles.
skills.detailZh: 能用巨鎚打出決定性重擊，對金屬障礙尤其有效。

skills.detailEn: Produces special gears and forged parts for lifts and high-tier builds.
skills.detailZh: 可打造升降平台與高階工程需要的特殊齒輪與鍛件。

pokemon.descriptionEn: Meditite heightens its inner energy through meditation. It survives on just one berry a day. Minimal eating is another aspect of this Pokémon’s training.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 瑪沙那會透過冥想提升自身的內在能量。牠一天只靠一顆樹果維生，而刻意少吃也是牠修行的一部分。

skills.detailEn: Carries heavy materials and helps raise large structures with stable output.
skills.detailZh: 擅長搬運重物並穩定推進大型建築施工。

skills.detailEn: Relies on disciplined strength to smash barriers and overpower strong foes.
skills.detailZh: 以紮實力道擊破障礙，也能正面壓制強敵。

skills.detailEn: Improves work pace when multiple builders are assigned to the same project.
skills.detailZh: 多名建造夥伴同場施工時，能顯著提升協作效率。

pokemon.descriptionEn: Through the power of meditation, Medicham developed its sixth sense. It gained the ability to use psychokinetic powers. This Pokémon is known to meditate for a whole month without eating.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 恰雷姆透過冥想之力發展出第六感，也因此獲得操縱念力的能力。據說牠甚至能不吃不喝地持續冥想整整一個月。

skills.detailEn: Carries heavy materials and helps raise large structures with stable output.
skills.detailZh: 擅長搬運重物並穩定推進大型建築施工。

skills.detailEn: Relies on disciplined strength to smash barriers and overpower strong foes.
skills.detailZh: 以紮實力道擊破障礙，也能正面壓制強敵。

skills.detailEn: Improves work pace when multiple builders are assigned to the same project.
skills.detailZh: 多名建造夥伴同場施工時，能顯著提升協作效率。

pokemon.descriptionEn: It stores electricity in its fur. It gives off sparks from all over its body in seasons when the air is dry.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 會在體毛中儲存靜電。 在空氣乾燥的季節 會從全身散發出火花。

skills.detailEn: Feeds stable power into lights, stations, and industrial equipment.
skills.detailZh: 可為照明、充電站與工業設備提供穩定電力。

skills.detailEn: Delivers a sharp electrical burst suited for generators, traps, and quick strikes.
skills.detailZh: 釋放瞬間強電流，適合啟動設備、癱瘓機關與快速打擊。

skills.detailEn: Relays energy into larger networks such as lighthouses, towers, and hubs.
skills.detailZh: 可把電力穩定轉接到燈塔、高塔與樞紐等大型設施。

pokemon.descriptionEn: It rarely appears before people. It is said to nest where lightning has fallen.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 極少在人們面前現身， 據說牠的住所就在 雷電落下的地方。

skills.detailEn: Feeds stable power into lights, stations, and industrial equipment.
skills.detailZh: 可為照明、充電站與工業設備提供穩定電力。

skills.detailEn: Delivers a sharp electrical burst suited for generators, traps, and quick strikes.
skills.detailZh: 釋放瞬間強電流，適合啟動設備、癱瘓機關與快速打擊。

skills.detailEn: Relays energy into larger networks such as lighthouses, towers, and hubs.
skills.detailZh: 可把電力穩定轉接到燈塔、高塔與樞紐等大型設施。

pokemon.descriptionEn: A named story character — a Rotom that serves as the town's resident DJ. It supplies the music and ambient energy that bring your restored settlements to life, spinning tracks as the community grows.
pokemon.descriptionZh: 具名劇情角色——擔任城鎮駐場 DJ 的洛託姆（Rotom）。牠提供音樂與氛圍能量，隨著聚落成長放送樂曲，為你復興的據點注入生氣。

skills.detailEn: Keeps the settlement lively with sound, current, and responsive machines.
skills.detailZh: 以聲音、電流與活化設備讓聚落保持生氣。

skills.detailEn: Crackles with fast electrical arcs that can jolt nearby hazards into place.
skills.detailZh: 可釋放快速電弧，震住周邊危險裝置或擾動目標。

skills.detailEn: As the resident DJ, it gives rebuilt towns identity rather than mere functionality.
skills.detailZh: 作為 DJ 角色，牠讓重建聚落不只有功能，還真正擁有生活感。
